title: Nutty Silky Filipino Beef-Brisket Adobo
description: A kid-friendly Filipino dish featuring tender beef brisket in a rich and nutty sauce, perfect for families and Whole30 diets.

ingredients.name: Beef brisket
ingredients.notes: Choose a cut with some marbling for tenderness

ingredients.name: Coconut oil
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a cold-pressed, unrefined oil

ingredients.name: Coconut vinegar
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a brand that is free from additives

instructions: In a large Dutch oven or heavy pot, heat the coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the grated ginger and sauté for another minute.
Add the beef brisket and sear on all sides until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the ground anise, bay leaves, black pepper, coconut vinegar, and water.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the pot with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise the beef for 2-3 hours, or until tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Strain the sauce through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl, discarding the solids.
Return the beef to the pot and simmer the sauce over low heat until it has thickened.
Slice the beef against the grain and serve with the sauce spooned over the top.
